note: Revised from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes the soldier and the worker, records the alate as unknown and does not describe the nymph. Two figures for the worker, total body length and head length, were not recorded because of OCR damage, and literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow; frons and labrum red; mandibles reddish brown, reddish at the base; antennae and pronotum pale yellow; abdomen and legs milky white. Head sparsely setose, body moderately so. Total body length 4.6–5.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight, posterior margin rounded; length to mandibular base 1.54–1.63 mm, maximum width 0.95–1.00 mm; frons slightly inclined anteriorly. Fontanelle small and distinct, situated in the anterior third of the dorsal surface of the head. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus setose, indistinctly delimited from the frons; anteclypeus bare, transparent, band-like. Labrum subquadrate, anterior margin rounded; length 0.18–0.20 mm, width 0.28–0.30 mm. Mandibles coarsely serrate, about two-thirds of the head length, 0.95–1.03 mm long. Left mandible with a large tooth-like serration slightly below the middle; right mandible with a similar serration at about one-third of the distance from the base. Postmentum rod-shaped; widest in the anterior quarter, narrowest at the waist near the base; length 0.85–0.98 mm, maximum width 0.34–0.38 mm, waist width 0.20–0.23 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin rounded with a weak median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, slightly incurved medially; length 0.30–0.34 mm, maximum width 0.58–0.68 mm. Mesonotum as wide as the pronotum, metanotum slightly wider than the pronotum; posterior margins of both slightly incurved.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale golden yellow, anterior part pale yellow; antennae and pronotum pale yellow; legs and abdomen milky white. Head and body moderately setose. Head capsule subquadrate, wider than long, maximum width 0.80–0.98 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, sparsely setose, longer than half its width; anteclypeus transparent, bare, with the middle of the anterior margin projecting forwards. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.23–0.26 mm, width 0.53–0.58 mm; anterior and posterior margins convex, neither notched.
